Background: RFC 4293 deprecates existing individual
type counters to be replaced with the ICMPMsgStatsTable. This table
includes entries for both IPv4 and IPv6
ICMP types
column2: whether or not the machine implements the type.

column1: These patches ""remove"" (but not really) the existing counters
replace them with the ICMPMsgStats tables for v4 and v6.
It includes the named counters in the /proc places they were
values for them from the new tables. It also counts packets generated
from raw socket output (e.g.
radvd
Changes:
1) create icmpmsg_statistics mib
2) create icmpv6msg_statistics mib
3) modify existing counters to use these
4) modify /proc/net/snmp to add ""IcmpMsg"" with all ICMP types
listed by number for easy SNMP parsing
5) modify /proc/net/snmp printing for ""Icmp"" to get the named data
from new counters.
[new to 2nd revision]
6) support per-interface ICMP stats
7) use common macro for per-device stat macros
